config.text: 24/7 Ballot Drop Boxes

Secure Ballot Drop Boxes will be available 24 hours a day, seven days a week, starting at

8 a.m. on Wednesday, October 7, until 7 p.m. on Election Day, Tuesday, November 3.
Buzón de votación

Buzón abierto las 24 horas del día,

desde las 8 de la mañana del 7/10/2026

hasta las 7 de la tarde del 3/11/2026

The Regional Transportation Authority Special Election is an all-mail election that culminates on Tuesday, March 10, 2026, at 7PM.


Find key dates, election results, and other important voter information at pima.vote.


How to Use Vote Center Locations Map


To use the app, enable location services on your device and turn off ad and popup blockers. By using this application, you are agreeing to the Pima County ITD GIS Disclaimer & Use Restrictions

﻿Mobile Voting Sites

Each location operates for 1-Day ONLY

Review the posted date and time before planning a visit


10/27 - Marana - Marana Aquatic & Recreation Center

10/29 - Three Points - Robles Ranch Community Center

10/30 & 10/31 - Sells - Tohono Plaza (Bashas' Plaza)

11/2 - Ajo - Salazar-Ajo Library

﻿Centros de votación móviles

Cada ubicación opera SOLO durante un día. Revise la fecha y la hora publicadas antes de planificar su visita.


27/10 - Marana - Marana Aquatic & Recreation Center

29/10 - Three Points - Robles Ranch Community Center
